subject: revision_change_evidence_gap
claim: The repository does not yet contain a verified comparison of two user-owned client revisions that establishes the complete added, removed, and changed archive, zone, and locale file lists.
how_to_repeat: Read the F-15 row in doc/CONTRIBUTOR-TRACK.md and confirm that it asks for changes between two client revisions.
Inspect contrib/tools/ambrose-install-diff/README.md and confirm that the tool requires two user-provided installation folders and reports only archive, zone, and locale paths.
Search contrib/findings/data/ for an existing revision comparison finding and search the repository for a committed pair of client installations or a committed client-derived comparison report.

Run ambrose-install-diff against two separate copies of the user's own installations, record the revisions from their Bin/revision.dat files, and preserve only the path names, sizes, and summary in a future finding.
evidence: The F-15 row identifies the desired result as a list of archives, zones, and locale files that changed between two client revisions.
ambrose-install-diff/README.md says that the tool reads two user-provided installations at runtime and reports added, removed, and changed files in those three categories.
ambrose-install-diff/README.md states that other files are ignored and that its FNV-1a digest is a change detector rather than a cryptographic identity.
No file exists under contrib/findings/data/ in this checkout, and no client installation, archive, capture, or extracted data was added to the repository.
disproof: A repository-approved report from two user-owned revisions that names both revisions and records the complete archive, zone, and locale file differences with a repeatable comparison method.
